$comment: The official keys of the signed web app (OpenSpec change signed-web-app, design D3 and D17). keys: the public halves (DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo, base64) of the release key and the offline recovery key, added by the maintainer when he creates them (tasks 0.2); their fingerprints are also in SECURITY.md and docs/security/signed-app.md, and scripts/repo-checks.test.mjs keeps them equal. refuse: false while checks only report; a release that sets it to true turns refusal on for every device that installs it, for good. Until a key is listed, CI cannot sign and builds read Self-built.
